dimensions.assessment: Directs federal auditors at the GAO and assesses Coast Guard personnel and marine transportation industry stakeholders.
dimensions.evidence: direct the Comptroller General of the United States to conduct a review of the budget, resources, and capabilities of the Coast Guard

dimensions.assessment: An evaluation and reporting requirement that does not directly alter agency powers, funding, or regulations on its own.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 270 days after the date of enactment of this Act, the Comptroller General... shall conduct a review

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending or appropriations are allocated by the text; mentions that maritime trade supports $2.1 trillion in economic activity.
